title: The Recurring Documentation Gap
brief: Monthly record audits at Meridian Care keep finding the same gap: the "allergies checked" field on the admission record is blank in about 8 percent of admissions. Action AC-9 says "staff reminded at huddle". This visit covers management system topics only. Clinical decisions, clinical standards, and law are outside its scope; the investigator does not judge clinical care. You have 12 visit points to reach a system cause.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: Admissions nurse: how the form is completed
Form designer: which fields are mandatory
A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Night coordinator: admissions out of hours
Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: AC-9 cause "staff forgetting", action "reminded at huddle", closed without a check; the gap rate is unchanged over 6 months.
evidence.whyItMatters: Corrective action must address the cause and be checked.

evidence.text: Audit results: 90 percent of blanks are on admissions entered through the transfer screen, not the main admission screen (audits RA-1 to RA-6).
evidence.whyItMatters: The pattern points to the system.
evidence.missedExplanation: Break audit data down by route.

evidence.text: Admissions nurse: "On the main screen it won't let you save without it."
The transfer screen version of the form (TF-2) lets the record be saved with the field blank.
evidence.whyItMatters: Service delivery tools must support complete records.
evidence.missedExplanation: Compare different routes into the same record.

evidence.text: Form change FC-7, 7 months ago, added the transfer screen; the mandatory rule was not copied. No test record.
evidence.whyItMatters: Changes must be reviewed and checked.
evidence.missedExplanation: Check changes made around the time the gap began.

evidence.text: Form designer gives a current list of mandatory fields for the main screen.
Training for the electronic form covers the main screen only (module EF-1).
evidence.whyItMatters: Training could include the transfer route.

evidence.text: Night coordinator: "Transfers mostly arrive at night." Consistent with audit data.
Staffing board shows the planned numbers.

evidence.whyItMatters: Reminders were given; they were not the cause.

decisions.prompt: Which statement best describes the system cause?
options: Night staff forget to complete the field
A form change added a transfer screen without the mandatory rule, without testing, and without training on that route
Patients do not know their allergies
decisions.rationale: The cause lies in the form change and its review. The investigator does not judge clinical practice.

containment: Run a daily report of blank fields on transfer admissions for staff to complete
correction: Complete the blank fields through the ward's defined process
cause: Form change FC-7 omitted the mandatory rule, was not tested, and training missed the transfer route
corrective: Make the field mandatory on the transfer screen, test form changes against a checklist, and add the route to training
effectiveness: Track the blank rate monthly for six months, target near zero

debriefText.found: You moved from "forgetting" to a form change.
debriefText.missed: Break audit data down by route.
debriefText.falseFinding: Planned staffing and given reminders were not causes.
